name: Glamered Plate
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 12th; Slot armor; Price 20,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Woven of a distilled essence made from stories of warriors dodging deadly blows, this cloth tunic protects its wearer as well as +3 full plate, but does not hinder his movements or skills (the wearers movement is not reduced and he suffers no armor check penalties).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, glory of the faithful; Cost 10,000 gp.

VARIANT

Island at the Axis of the World. Copyright 2011, EN Publishing; Author: Ryan Nock.
